newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dean Foods estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dean Foods estimates raised.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities said it raised earnings estimates for Dean Foods Corp after the dairy and vegetable company reported its fiscal 1997 third quarter earnings of $0.51 a share exceeded a consensus estimate of $0.44.

-- NatWest analyst David Nelson said he raised his fiscal 1997 fourth quarter earnings estimate to $0.65 from $0.60 which brings his fiscal 1997 year estimate to $2.07 from a previous estimate of $1.97. He also raised his fiscal 1998 year estimate to $2.35 from $2.20.

-- Nelson expects Dean Foods' results to benefit from the company's plans to improve the cost efficiency and focus of its business. He also expects Dean Foods to grow its market share by acquisition in the consolidating dairy and vegetable markets.
-- Shares of Dean Foods closed at 33-3/4 yesterday.
